facts.fact: The national statistics institute's report of August 2023 states that civil-status data are collected manually, on paper, from the registers of the 2,875 civil status centres (419 principal, 2,455 secondary), of which three in five function; BUNEC obtained 2018 figures only by going through the registers in 2020, covering about 62% of centres.

The report describes the Bureau National de l'État Civil (BUNEC) as the government's technical arm for civil status, charged under decree 2013/031 with supervising the centres, building a national civil-status file and drawing up a master plan for computerising the system; stated as at the report's date.
